QuestInfo.name: Scadur's Truth
QuestInfo.1: When you delivered the tails to Scadur, you found out that he couldn't hunt because of the Snow Witch. He says he has been worrying by himself, since he didn't want others to see his fear. It is kind of pathetic, given that he's a hunter and all. Anyway, Scadur would like to ask #bAlcaster#k to solve this problem. Talk to Alcaster.
QuestInfo.2: You told Alcaster about the Snow Witch and delivered Scadur's request.

yes.0: Alcaster is somewhere here in #bEl Nath#k. Please, don't tell anybody about this. People will make fun of me if they find out...

no.0: Hm... It's not too hard... Is it?

npc.0: Go see Alcaster. He is inside #bEl Nath Market#k.
